title: Palace respects Ombudsman filing of plunder case vs Romualdez
summary: Malacañang said it respects the Office of the Ombudsman’s decision to file a plunder case against former House Speaker Martin Romualdez, President Marcos’ cousin, over his alleged involvement in the…
